paragraphs.text: Salamander or newts (not to be confused with " Phyrexian newts ", the embryonic life stage of Old Phyrexians) is a creature type used for several different types of tailed short-nosed small animals with soft scaleless skin. Salamanders are amphibians like frogs . They are aquatic as a larva and semiterrestrial as an adult. They don't have scales like reptiles .

Mythical Salamanders are thought to be able to live in fire. This connection likely originates from the tendency of regular salamanders to dwell inside rotting logs. When placed into a fire, the salamander would attempt to escape from the log, lending to the belief that salamanders were created from flames. In Magic this association with fire is represented by "fire-breathing" or direct damage ability.
Salamanders are mainly blue -aligned, although the first salamanders were mono- red . Salamanders have also appeared in black and green .

The first salamander was Pyric Salamander in Mirage . Salamanders returned in the Tempest block with Flowstone Salamander in Tempest , as well as Scalding Salamander and Cinder Crawler in Exodus . The Tempest block salamanders would be the last new salamanders to be printed in red.
Magic 2012 printed the first blue -aligned ( Amphin Cutthroat ) and black -aligned ( Festering Newt ) salamanders.
Wormfang Newt ( JUD ) was originally printed as a Nightmare Beast , but has since been granted the salamander type in its Oracle text. Retroactively making it the first non-red salamander.
Salamanders can be found on various planes including: Dominaria , Ixalan , Lorwyn-Shadowmoor , Mirrodin/New Phyrexia , Ravnica and Shandalar . Salamander-folk can be found on Arcavios and Shandalar .
Newts are a common ingredient in witches ' brews. This is exemplified by the combo of Festering Newt , Bubbling Cauldron and Bogbrew Witch from Magic 2014 .

Kiora was featured as a humanoid axolotl on Kiora,Behemoth Beckoner as part of the ' Showcase: Bloomburrow Secret Lair . However, the ' Showcase: Bloomburrow Secret Lair is a complemenatry product to the Imagine: Courageous Critters showcase series which explicitly shows non-canon, "What if?" scenarios.
Arbomanders are giant amphibians native to Lorwyn 's Wanderwine River. Arbomanders have been known to grow as long as one hundred feet, though tales tell of examples five times that size.

When seen from the riverbank, the huge amphibians resemble floating sand bars encrusted with fungi, but their undersides were a pale sandy color that more or less matches the hazy brightness of the sky from this underwater vantage point. Their thick, paddle-shaped tails are almost twice as long as their bulky trunk, and the arbomanders' hind legs are more like long flippers than walking limbs. Their forelegs are splayed, webbed, and tipped with claws half as tall as a kithkin . All arbomanders spot feathery tendrils of varying length and shape growing from their gills - but the patterns of each arbomander's frill are unique, enabling keen observers to identify individuals. Though arbomanders tend to be lazy and sleepy beasts, they are capable of swallowing a merrow whole, and close encounters with them are best avoided.
While no natural salamanders have been observed on Ravnica , the Simic have used salamander genetic material for both experiments ( Pteramander ) and in augmentation ( Fin-Clade Fugitives ).

The amphin are a race of lanky, shrewd, partially aquatic humanoids on Shandalar who can dwell either in the briny depths or the overgrown shallows. They are simular in appearance to the Zendikari Surrakar , but the species are unrelated. Little is known about their civilization as yet; time will tell whether we see more of this salamander-folk in the future. Much like Saprazzan Merfolk they can live on land. This type debuted with Amphin Cutthroat in Magic 2012 , and later with Amphin Pathmage in Magic 2015 . The Amphin were revisited in Commander Legends with Amphin Mutineer and Gor Muldrak, Amphinologist .

Legend has it that the Amphins have used their mind control powers to erase all knowledge of their existence from the minds of humanity. In reality, the Amphins were an attempt to come up with a race of creatures that could occupy the ”medium-sized nonflying blue creature” slot. The experiment did not work out. In the meantime, the spot is held by various Elementals , Humans , Fish , or Spirits , though no civilization or race has held the spot permanently.
